item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson Military Watch Set is designed for those who demand both style and durability. This versatile watch set includes 3 interchangeable heavy-duty canvas watch bands in olive drab, black, and khaki, allowing you to maintain a professional look that matches your uniform or outfit. The watch features a round face with a black backing, showcasing the well-respected Smith & Wesson name and logo. It includes 3 luminous hands that display hours, minutes, and seconds, as well as a date display to keep you punctual.
description: The Smith & Wesson Military Watch Set is designed for those who demand both style and durability. This versatile watch set includes 3 interchangeable heavy-duty canvas watch bands in olive drab, black, and khaki, allowing you to maintain a professional look that matches your uniform or outfit. The watch features a round face with a black backing, showcasing the well-respected Smith & Wesson name and logo. It includes 3 luminous hands that display hours, minutes, and seconds, as well as a date display to keep you punctual. Constructed with a durable stainless-steel back and protected by a hardened mineral glass crystal, the watch is built to withstand rugged use. It operates on precision Japanese quartz movement and is powered by a long-lasting silver oxide battery. Water-resistant up to 30 meters, this watch is a reliable companion for adventurers and professionals alike.
